human_instructions_incorporated.summary: Use the exact headline ENCERRAMENTO DO CARRINHO.

creative_thesis.thesis_statement: The viewer is caught at the instant access is being withdrawn, with a credible authority figure controlling the final opening rather than shouting a generic sale.
creative_thesis.communication_problem: Create immediate urgency for a cart-closing thumbnail without producing panic or cheap discount language.
creative_thesis.creative_answer: Turn closure into an active spatial event moving across the scene while the subject remains composed and authoritative.
creative_thesis.desired_viewer_perception: This is a real final window, and the person presenting it is in control.
creative_thesis.rationale: Movement supplies urgency while the subject supplies trust and finality.

commercial_psychology.rationale: The brief supports urgency; authority is the chosen quality that keeps it credible.

narrative_tension.subject_role: The composed gatekeeper announcing a consequential final moment.
narrative_tension.environment_role: A space visibly compressing and closing around the available path.
narrative_tension.relationship: The subject remains stable while the environment carries acceleration.
narrative_tension.rationale: Contrasting human stability with environmental motion avoids frantic sales imagery.

subject_strategy.perceived_character: Decisive, credible, calm under time pressure
subject_strategy.relationship_to_environment: Integrated through overlapping depth and shared directional energy, never pasted over a backdrop
subject_strategy.relationship_to_viewer: Direct address that makes the deadline personally relevant
identity_requirements: Do not distort identity for dramatic effect

emotional_strategy.rationale: Urgency should feel consequential and controlled.

visual_hierarchy.reason: Trust must precede the deadline claim.
Makes finality felt rather than merely stated.
visual_hierarchy.relationship_to_previous: Frames and accelerates attention away from the stable subject.

visual_hierarchy.reason: Names the event after attention is secured.
visual_hierarchy.relationship_to_previous: Receives momentum from the closure mechanism.

creative_concept.visual_world: A compressed threshold whose layers are actively converging around one remaining path.
creative_concept.narrative_function: Make closure an event occurring now.
creative_concept.composition_logic: Stable human mass opposed by directional environmental pressure.
creative_concept.depth_logic: Foreground and environmental layers cross one another to create real spatial compression.
creative_concept.environment_logic: Every environmental element either narrows the path or directs attention; nothing is decorative.
creative_concept.typography_role: Headline acts as the formal announcement of the closing event, secondary to human authority.

candidates.concept_summary: A remaining access corridor closes around an authoritative subject.
candidates.core_mechanism: Directional compression around a stable focal figure
risks: Closure can become visually chaotic if every layer competes
candidates.decision_reason: Best combines authority, movement and immediate finality.

candidates.concept_summary: A large timer dominates the frame.
candidates.decision_reason: It explains urgency literally but does not create an ownable narrative.

candidates.concept_summary: Alarm color and warning symbols create pressure.
candidates.decision_reason: Intensity comes from generic alarm codes rather than meaningful tension.

ideation.convergence_summary: The selected route keeps the legibility of a deadline but converts it into spatial narrative instead of a timer or alarm graphic.

selected_direction.name: The Last Opening
selected_direction.concept: A credible authority figure occupies the last stable point while the opportunity visibly closes through the surrounding space.
selected_direction.why_it_won: It makes urgency experiential while preserving trust and subject dominance.
selected_direction.core_visual_idea: Stability at the center of controlled directional collapse.
required_perception: Action is still possible but not indefinitely
selected_direction.creative_risk: Overstating motion could create panic or obscure the headline.
selected_direction.originality_strategy: Express the deadline through spatial behavior rather than clocks, red alerts or sale badges.

visual_mechanisms.name: CONVERGING_ACCESS_COMPRESSION
visual_mechanisms.function: Narrow the perceived path through directional masses.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Carries the cart-closing narrative without literal countdown imagery.

visual_mechanisms.name: FOREGROUND_OCCLUSION
visual_mechanisms.function: Create layers that visibly pass in front of and behind the subject.

visual_mechanisms.name: DIRECTIONAL_MOTION
visual_mechanisms.function: Move attention from the subject through closure toward the headline.

retrieved_mechanisms.how_adapted: Used as closing environmental layers rather than decorative foreground blur.

selected_mechanisms.how_adapted: Occluding layers participate in the closure narrative.

adaptation_notes: VKB supplied an abstract depth precedent; the Creative Director assigned its narrative function.

creative_constraints.statement: The subject must remain the perceptual focal point.
Depth must integrate the subject with the closing event.
creative_constraints.rationale: A pasted portrait would break the narrative.

banned_tropes.name: LITERAL_TIMER_CLICHE
banned_tropes.description: Countdown clock used as the main idea.
banned_tropes.reason: Predictable and substitutes a symbol for direction.

banned_tropes.name: CHEAP_DISCOUNT_VISUAL_LANGUAGE
banned_tropes.description: Sale badges, alarm bursts or random red warning graphics.

frozen_decisions.decision: Subject dominates before the closure mechanism and headline.
Urgency is expressed through converging spatial motion.
frozen_decisions.rationale: This is the central creative idea.

open_decisions.decision: Exact lens, light positions and arrangement of closing layers.
open_decisions.rationale: These are technical implementations of the frozen mechanism.

provenance.notes: Stores external rationales and decisions only.

confidence.rationale: The direction directly resolves urgency, authority and cliché avoidance.

approval.notes: Ready for technical design; no human approval claimed.

technical_handoff.creative_goal: Make cart closure feel active, credible and consequential.
technical_handoff.selected_direction_summary: A stable authority figure holds the last opening while the surrounding space closes directionally.

hierarchy.relationship_to_previous: Moves away from the stable subject.

known_risks: Too much motion can create panic
Closing layers can compete with the headline
